query:
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.startTime,
  a.therapyType,
  a.status,
  p.name as patient_name,
  YEAR(a.startTime) as year,
  MONTH(a.startTime) as month
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Antonella%Salles%'
ORDER BY a.startTime DESC
LIMIT 20;
